name: Base
description: Canonical design conventions established across the Bookmarks app (sessions 1-3), compiled from the census of established roles and the project's gap/proposal records. Version 0.1.1-experiment adds declared validators (base-lint).

policy.on_undefined: Improvise in character using the project's existing token vocabulary (the semantic custom properties in styles.css), mark the improvisation, and report a gap; do not invent new primitives.
policy.on_conflict: Reject the raw value and use the semantic token or the canonical treatment named by the cited rule.
policy.proposals: A need may be proposed only after the census classifies a compatible treatment as Established across at least two distinct opportunities; proposals are recorded in .design-authority/proposals and promoted only through an owner verdict.
